description:
Trigger a DNS/HTTP verification check for a pending domain verification.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: trigger_verification

channel.description: Channel used for verification. Not yet available — a create or start naming one answers 400 `channel_not_available`: github, google, facebook, x, linkedin, instagram, youtube, tiktok, ethereum, solana, bitcoin, coinbase, kraken.

identifier.description: The identifier being verified; absent for an identifier-free phone verification, whose number is learned only when the person completes it

type.description: Type of asset being verified. Not yet available — no channel of theirs can be completed, so a create or start answers 400 `channel_not_available`: social, wallet, account.
